title: Recover P via g=e(P0,Q) on the valid plain P10 GT STNFS core (rec7 run-coset record walk, scan2 kernels): 119.48269408641

claims.statement: For the production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 target, the algorithm of proof.md returns P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the exact supplied uniform nonidentity Q (z=1 gives P=infinity) with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins under the disclosed heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). It forms g=e(P0,Q) (uniform nonidentity, independent of the uniform target z: exactly the core's input distribution), converts g and z into the STNFS tower by the charged field map of field-map.md, computes a=log_g(z) with the GT STNFS core and returns P=[a]P0 after checking e(P,Q)=z. The core is the GT core of our valid plain P10 9c904850, byte-identical (recover-Q 9332a74d's with our v7/v8 levers and the changes of our plain P5-P8): theta=2326/8000 sized on pool B and judged once on a fresh pool D (retained relations >= 2^63.6016, 0.0798 bits above 1.05 U), measured wide-prime and line kernels; new here, primes in [2^56, 2^63) walked once per canonical a-run (rec7; one implementation per run and band, runs of 32 to 1,024 a-values) and the scan2, apply and recover kernels of our overhead lane, scan charged over every leaf length 1..64. Work on pools B, C, D with allowance 1.0048: collection <= 2^119.180693087 units; N <= 2^58.7868, Block Wiedemann (28, 5): linear algebra <= 2^116.981242966, generator <= 2^107.555167552; 62-node lazy descent, meter 2^113.104; rec7 bases 2^68.3; upper-rounded core ledger rows sum to at most 2^119.48269408635 <= 2^119.4826940864 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Total classical work, including all preprocessing, both logarithms, failures, the field map, pairings, verification and output, is at most 2^119.4826940864 + 2^80/20000 < 2^119.48269408641 dense-Fp12 units (C=20,000). Peak storage below 2^106 bytes; no advice and no amortization. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Hosted audit. {}: code identity, parameters, recorded full-run certificate, integration probes, lazy bound vs a simulation, core ledger and success, recover-P total with the 2^80-instruction wrapper (80-digit). {"descent": true} also re-evaluates the descent recurrence, node counter and success. evidence16.py (local, about 4 minutes natively, not a hosted experiment) reruns every certificate and check.

Rerun the package's filtering simulation (filtsim.py, purge target 0.0001) at relation excess 1.05 (default; optional 'excess') and the shipped means to mean weight 100, 200 or 300 (default 300) and report the fraction of row weight carried by +-1 entries (against the charged 0.87) and U/N. Optional. Evidence at its scale only; production is extrapolated (H4u, H3).
